replies.author: @truehorizons66
replies.text: Thank you for raising this. Trinidad and Tobago is a very diverse society, and any documentary about the country should reflect that diversity more carefully. We understand your concern about how different communities were represented, and we’ll keep that in mind when reviewing and producing future videos.

comments.text: Actually, the first musical instrument of T&T is the tamboo bamboo and when the British banned the tamboo bamboo, the steelpan was born.
